title: Stop Checking the Same Pages Every Day
summary: Hand off the prices, rules and competitor pages you keep refreshing, and get a message only when something changes what you would decide.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes you check the same pages by hand each week; the value is time saved and changes caught early.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Hours back each month from checking pages by hand.
You hear about a price or rule change before it costs you.
who_its_for: Owners who track suppliers, rules or competitors.
Founders who follow one market closely.

stack.name: When It Matters
stack.role: Works out what would change your answer and messages you only then.
stack.creator: hnshah

stack.name: Competitor Watch
stack.role: Tracks competitor pricing, product and hiring pages and briefs you on real changes.
stack.creator: Shimecki

stack.name: Market Research
stack.role: Writes source-graded notes on your market watchlist.
stack.creator: eyemotors

steps: List the things you check every week.
Agree what counts as a change worth a message.
Add competitor pages to the watch list.
Read the alerts and act only on the ones that matter.
guardrails: Check the source behind an alert before you act on it.
Alerts are not legal or financial advice.
